changelog: Full modularization of oversized server codebase into clean, dedicated, single-responsibility files (idfix.lua, web_api.lua, spectate.lua, staff_notes.lua).
Isolated Web HTTP API handler and real-time live heartbeat sync into server/web_api.lua.
Decoupled IDFix unique ID synchronization and reconciling into server/idfix.lua.
Centralized staff notes and searchable audit logs into server/staff_notes.lua.
Updated manifest registrations and Tebex escrow exclusions for all modular components.
